# Upcoming events

**Note on events in German language**  

Accompanying the current exhibition, you can expect diverse and interesting events. In addition to exhibition-related events such as guided tours with the curators, lectures, studio courses for children and our series Introduction to the Exhibition, the programme also includes series of events organised by the ZEIT-Stiftung, such as the literature series Literatur zur Lage. Most of the events are held in German.  

[Click here for the entire programme (in German)](/veranstaltungen "Entire programme in German").

[All Events](/en/note-on-events-in-german-language)

**Become a friend: Support art and enjoy all benefits!**  
As a member of the Bucerius Kunst Club, you support the work of the Bucerius Kunst Forum and receive a special insight into the exhibition house. You will enjoy many benefits, such as free admission to the exhibitions.

[more information](https://www.buceriuskunstforum.de/en/club)

**Browse through the Bucerius Book Shop on site or online**  
The Book Shop at the Bucerius Kunst Forum offers you a selection of specialist literature tailored to the current exhibition. In addition, you will find fine gift ideas and valuable stationery as well as fashionable accessories and exclusive design objects for art and design enthusiasts. Visit the Book Shop on site, before or after your visit to the exhibition, or order your favorites digitally in the new online Book Shop.

[More information](https://www.buceriuskunstforum.de/en/bucerius-book-shop-1) [Online-Book-Shop —](https://bucerius-bookshop.de/)

## Kunstmeile Hamburg

![](/fileadmin/_processed_/7/2/csm_Header-Website-Flaggen_9cfa25f2dc.jpg)

**Discover Hamburg's art with the Kunstmeile Ticket**  
In addition to the Bucerius Kunst Forum, the Kunstmeile Hamburg includes the Hamburger Kunsthalle, the Deichtorhallen Hamburg, the Kunstverein Hamburg, the Kunsthaus Hamburg and the Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg. The Kunstmeile Hamburg, which is within walking distance between the Alster and the Elbe, invites you to discover the six renowned houses. Whether with the 12-month or 3-day ticket.

[More information](https://www.buceriuskunstforum.de/en/visit/event-tickets/exhibition-tickets/kunstmeile-hamburg)
